Immaculada

A Home Celebration for Immaculada

Welcome the Advent season with the warmth and traditions of Immaculada, right in your own home. This agenda offers a practical guide to honor this special day with family and festive treats.

  1. Dawn

    A Quiet Dawn Reflection

    While we can't join a plaza procession, start your day with quiet contemplation or gentle Spanish music to honor Mary's conception and the start of Advent.

  2. Morning

    Decorate with Blue and White

    Bring the festive spirit indoors by hanging blue-and-white bunting around your home, symbolizing the purity and grace of the Immaculate Conception.

  3. Late Morning

    Prepare and Enjoy Panellets

    Gather your family to make these delightful small almond cakes, a traditional treat for the season. Enjoy them fresh from the oven with a warm beverage.

    Recipes: Panellets (Catalan Almond Cookies)

  4. Afternoon

    Introduce Caga Tio

    Set out your Caga Tio log in a special spot. Begin the charming tradition of 'feeding' him with small sweets, building anticipation for Christmas Eve.

  5. Late Afternoon

    Bake the Roscon

    Prepare the festive Roscon, a sweet bread often enjoyed during this season. Its aroma will fill your home with holiday cheer.

    Recipes: Festive Roscón (Sweet Bread Ring)

  6. Evening

    Candlelit Vigil & Advent Candles

    Create your own quiet vigil at home. Light your Advent candles, reflecting on the meaning of the season and setting intentions for the coming weeks.

  7. After Vigil

    Festive Feast & Sharing

    Gather around the table to share slices of your freshly baked Roscon, sip on steaming cups of thick hot chocolate, and enjoy pieces of sweet turron.

    Recipes: Festive Roscón (Sweet Bread Ring) · Traditional Holiday Hot Chocolate · Turron de Alicante (Hard Almond Nougat)

May your home be filled with peace and joy as you begin the beautiful journey of Advent.
